name: Hibiscus
description: Hibiscus, often referred to as Chinese hibiscus or scarlet rosemallow, is a flowering plant known for its vibrant red flowers. The plant also has various applications in skincare and haircare due to the presence of antioxidants and other beneficial compounds.
best_for: Hair that needs moisture and nutrition
Individuals looking to improve their skin's elasticity and reduce signs of aging
how_to_use: Add hibiscus extract or infused oil to face masks, serums, and moisturizers.
Use hibiscus tea as a toner for the face.
Incorporate hibiscus flower essence into hair conditioners or rinse treatments.
possible_side_effects: May cause skin irritation if used undiluted
scientific_evidence: Studies have shown that hibiscus extract contains antioxidants like anthocyanins, which can help protect the skin from oxidative stress. Research also indicates that its anti-inflammatory properties may be beneficial for managing certain skin conditions. In hair care, hibiscus has been found to contain compounds that promote scalp health and prevent protein loss in hair.
